name: Rutschebanen
description: One of the world's oldest wooden roller coasters still in operation, thrilling riders since 1914. What makes Rutschebanen truly unique is the brakeman who rides in every train, manually controlling the speed throughout the journey — one of only seven roller coasters in the world to still feature this extraordinary tradition. A rattling, exhilarating ride through a painted mountain that has delighted generations of Danes.

name: Demon
description: Tivoli's most intense roller coaster featuring three full loops and a range of twisting inversions at 80 km/h. Opened in 1985, Demon remains the park's premier thrill machine, delivering powerful G-forces and heart-stopping loops against the backdrop of Tivoli's illuminated gardens.

name: Himmelskibet
description: Tivoli's tallest attraction soaring 80 metres above the rooftops of Copenhagen — the world's tallest carousel ride. As the arms extend and riders spin outward, the entire Copenhagen cityscape unfolds in a breathtaking 360-degree panorama. On a clear day you can see the Øresund Bridge stretching towards Sweden. An unmissable Tivoli experience.

name: Golden Tower
description: A thrilling 63-metre freefall tower that launches riders skyward before dropping them in a stomach-churning plummet back to earth. The Golden Tower is visible across Tivoli's skyline and offers spectacular aerial views of the gardens below during the ascent before the terrifying drop.

name: Aquila
description: A spectacular giant swing ride that rotates riders high above Tivoli's gardens at exhilarating speed. Aquila delivers powerful G-forces and sweeping aerial views of the park's illuminated landscape — a thrilling experience that combines the beauty of Tivoli's gardens with pure adrenaline.

name: Monsunen
description: A thrilling water ride that takes riders on a journey through exotic scenes before plunging down a dramatic waterfall drop. Perfect for cooling off on a warm Copenhagen summer day, Monsunen guarantees a soaking and delivers screams and laughter in equal measure.

name: Flying Trunk
description: A magical boat dark ride inspired by the fairy tales of Hans Christian Andersen, Tivoli's most beloved family attraction. Guests glide through enchanting scenes from The Little Mermaid, Thumbelina, The Snow Queen and other classic Danish fairy tales in beautifully crafted sets full of charm and wonder.

name: The Carousel
description: A beautifully restored historic carousel dating back to the Victorian era, one of Tivoli's most photographed and cherished attractions. Hand-crafted horses, carriages and mythical creatures make up this magnificent roundabout that has enchanted children and adults alike for generations in the heart of the gardens.

name: Ferris Wheel
description: Tivoli's classic Ferris wheel offering gentle, sweeping views over the illuminated gardens and Copenhagen city rooftops. Especially magical at night when Tivoli's thousands of lights twinkle below, the Ferris wheel is a romantic and timeless attraction perfect for couples and families.

name: The Swing Carousel
description: A delightful classic swing carousel that sends riders soaring gently outward above Tivoli's lush gardens. A beloved family favourite that has been a fixture of Tivoli's landscape for decades, offering a gentle thrill with beautiful views of the surrounding park.

name: The Astronomer
description: A charming family dark ride taking guests on a whimsical astronomical journey through the cosmos. Themed around Danish astronomer Tycho Brahe, this gentle ride is a perfect introduction to Tivoli's unique blend of education, fantasy and entertainment for the youngest visitors.

name: Mælkevejen
description: A fantastical children's dark ride journeying through a magical milky way of twinkling stars and colourful cosmic scenes. One of Tivoli's most charming family attractions, perfectly designed for young children experiencing the magic of Tivoli for the very first time.

name: Tik Tak
description: A classic giant swinging ship ride delivering powerful pendulum thrills. Tik Tak swings riders high into the air above Tivoli's gardens with sweeping G-forces, a timeless fairground experience that has delivered screams and laughter at Tivoli for decades.
